title: Travel policy
text: Domestic flights costing more than AUD 600 must be approved by the director of the traveller's department.

title: Organisation chart
text: Engineering director: Priya Raman. Finance director: Tom Nguyen. Sales director: Ana Costa.

title: Office locations
text: The engineering team works from the Melbourne office. The sales team works from the Sydney office.

title: Meal allowance
text: Daily meal allowance: AUD 85 in Melbourne and AUD 95 in Sydney.

title: Model R7 specification
text: The R7 delivery robot uses the BP-200 battery pack and is built at the Geelong plant.

title: BP-200 battery pack
text: The BP-200 battery pack carries a 3-year warranty and is supplied by VoltCell Pty Ltd.

title: Geelong plant
text: The Geelong plant's safety officer is Mei Lin. The plant runs two shifts.

title: Supplier terms: VoltCell
text: VoltCell Pty Ltd is paid on 45-day terms.

title: Leave policy
text: Staff accrue 20 days of annual leave a year. Unused leave above 30 days must be approved by the department director.

title: Salary bands
text: Engineer L3 salary band: AUD 140,000 to 165,000.
